# ProcureSignal

> ProcureSignal is an independent Africa-first procurement intelligence product for SMEs and tender consultants. It is not affiliated with any government entity or official tender portal.

## Public content

- [ProcureSignal](https://procuresignal.io/)
- [Pricing](https://procuresignal.io/pricing)
- [Privacy Notice](https://procuresignal.io/privacy)
- [Terms and Disclaimer](https://procuresignal.io/terms)

## Product facts

- ProcureSignal helps users prioritize public-sector opportunities using explainable fit, buyer, source-quality, official-link, and deadline signals.
- The product currently has 21 configured live procurement sources. Coverage is partial and source-specific.
- ProcureSignal analysis is decision support, not an official procurement record, eligibility decision, award guarantee, or bid-submission service.
- Users must verify documents, addenda, deadlines, briefing requirements, eligibility rules, and submission instructions on the official issuing authority source.

## Access boundary

Account, billing, workspace, saved opportunity, protected document, internal API, source telemetry, and orchestration routes are private or operational surfaces and are not public citation targets.
